crossRefs.note: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly…
He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they…
The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases…
But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.
The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,
News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

translations.web: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
translations.bsb: And the news about Jesus spread quickly through the whole region of Galilee.
translations.kjv: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
translations.asv: And the report of him went out straightway everywhere into all the region of Galilee round about.
